profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Software engineer with more than 14 years of industry experience. Interested in Distributed System, Big Data, functional programming, programming languages, etc…

Experience with many programming languages, including C#, Python, Go, Java, Scala, F#, C++.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building systems to guarantee Google Cloud customers resources availability and obtainability. 

Saved $XXM by designing and implementing systems to optimize infrastructure resources at scale reducing cost, increase efficiency, and reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building tools to enable capacity in Google Cloud to quickly, safely, and automatically move to prevent stockouts and maximize efficiency.

Design and implementation of a system that automates the movement of SSD capacity between GCE and the rest of Google to maximize utilization and improve efficiency of SSD disks.

Designed and implemented systems that allow VMs to be scheduled at the best possible hardware, which optimizes performance while increasing efficiency and reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of Google Compute Engine (GCE) building the tooling that manages GCE VMs underlying infrastructure. Mostly writing Go or Python and helping GCP Persistent Disk (PD) and Local SSD products to server customers at Google hyper-scale.

Implementation of the system that optimizes the usage of SSD disks in the GCE fleet to guarantee different demands are met at any moment in time.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Using the MapR Data Platform to help our customers to design, implement, and deploy BigData solutions on top of the MapR Data Platform & HPE Container Platform. 

Committer to internal MapR Spark implementation by adding optimized functionality to access MapR-Database and newest Kafka and MapR-ES APIs.

Committer to Apache Drill via Custom Storage Plugins implementations for customer indexing systems on top of MapR-Database.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helping MapR customers run their businesses on top of MapR Data Platform. 
Committer to internal MapR Spark implementation. Added optimized functionality to access MapR-Database and newest Kafka / MapR-ES APIs. 

Contributor to the following MapR tools:
 - akka-persistence-maprdb (github.com/anicolaspp/akka-persistence-maprdb)
 - dojai (github.com/anicolaspp/dojai)
 - MapRDBConnector (github.com/anicolaspp/MapRDBConnector)
 - mapr-data-gen (github.com/anicolaspp/mapr-data-gen)
 - ojai-testing (github.com/anicolaspp/ojai-testing)
 - ojai-generics (github.com/anicolaspp/ojai-generics)
 - maprdb-cleaner (github.com/anicolaspp/maprdb-cleaner)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineering of core micro-services for Royal Caribbean Cruises (RCCL) web and mobile systems that allow multiple core systems on the RCCL to run in the ships even though ship connectivity is low and many time non-existent. For instance, the micro-services for managing data streaming and replication from/to the cruises in a reactive and distributed manner. All of these systems use the Lightbend Reactive Platform, Lagom, Play framework, Kafka and Confluent Kafka Connect, and Cassandra.

Additionally, also worked on a set of micro-services that expose Commerce APIs to the different Royal Caribbean Mobile Apps so that customer can access multiple services during the trip and while oversea when there is no connectivity and the ship works as a datacenter itself which is quite challenging, specially for payment related operations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of Big Data team that enables information access at scale by building Big Data Pipelines using Amazon technologies to enable access to Subway POS payment information which allows access to previously unknown insights about customer activities. 

Using AWS BigData core technologies such as AWS S3, Data Pipelines, EMR, Redshift, DynamoDB alongside with Scala, and Apache Spark to build the end to end pipelines processing the related payment information from the Subway POS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building Big Data solutions to enable supply chain insights using multiple Hadoop distributions for BigData processing. Apache Spark and Scala where core technologies which helped taking advantage of Stream Processing along with Apache Kafka, MapR Streams, Apache Spark Streaming, and Akka Streams.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Building payment infrastructure for Blackstone POS and Ingenico hardware using C# / .NET Framework, and Xamaring for mobile development within a PCI-DSS compliance environment.

projects.title: HxFactory
projects.description: Factory library to create and run Hystrix commands with simplicity. Hystrix(part of Netflix OSS) is a latency and fault tolerance library designed to isolate points of access to remote systems, services and 3rd party libraries, stop cascading failure and enable resilience in complex distributed systems where failure is inevitable.

projects.title: TypeLevel/Dogs
projects.description: Purely Functional Data Structures for programming in Scala

Building on Top of Reactive Streams
